heroSummary: Spokane Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year with grades 1–12 Launch Conferences on August 24–25, followed by the first day for grades 1–12 on August 26. Kindergarten uses a staggered start, with all kindergarten students attending together on August 31. The district's first balanced-calendar year also adds new school breaks in October and February, with the last day scheduled for June 17, 2027.
calendarNotes: Grades 1–12 begin August 26. Kindergarten starts in smaller groups on August 27–28, all kindergarten students attend together August 31, PreK begins September 1, and AM/PM, CIP, and SSP preschool programs begin September 8. Current SPS information provides these program details and takes priority where it differs from the year-at-a-glance PDF currently linked by SPS. The 180-day balanced calendar adds October 19–23 and February 16–19 school breaks while retaining summer vacation. Most instructional Mondays still begin one hour late for staff collaboration. PLID days on October 9 and March 19 are non-student days, and June 21–22 remain conditional weather make-up dates after the scheduled last day.

customSections.label: Calendar Updates That Differ From the Year-at-a-Glance PDF
customSections.content:
The 2026–27 year-at-a-glance PDF currently linked by SPS shows kindergarten A/B rotation beginning August 26 and all kindergarten students attending August 28. Current SPS Back to School information instead lists Group A on August 27, Group B on August 28, and all kindergarten students on August 31. This page follows the newer, more detailed district information.

SPS's district conference information lists Launch Conferences on August 24–25. Browne Elementary's opening-date notice lists kindergarten conferences through August 26; families should follow the appointment dates provided by their school.

customSections.label: What the Balanced Calendar Changes—and Keeps
customSections.content: The 180-day calendar adds school breaks October 19–23 and February 16–19 while retaining Winter Break, Spring Break, and summer vacation. SPS describes the model as a balanced calendar, not year-round school. Most instructional Mondays still begin one hour late for staff collaboration. June 21–22 are reserved weather make-up days after the scheduled last day of school and remain conditional unless SPS activates them.

customSections.label: SPS Late-Start Mondays for 2026–27
customSections.content: Most instructional Mondays begin one hour late for staff collaboration. Holidays, school breaks, and non-student days interrupt the weekly pattern.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: SPS moves to a 180-day balanced calendar while retaining a summer break.
Grades 1–12 begin August 26 instead of September 2, and all kindergarten attends together August 31 instead of September 9.
The new calendar adds school breaks on October 19–23 and February 16–19.
Weather reserves move from three in-year non-student dates to June 21–22 after the scheduled last day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Spokane Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin Wednesday, August 26, 2026, after Launch Conferences August 24–25. Kindergarten follows a separate staggered opening.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Spokane kindergarten students start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten Group A attends August 27, Group B attends August 28, and all kindergarten students attend together August 31. Schools notify families of group assignments.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Spokane Public Schools preschool programs start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The district's four-day PreK program begins September 1. AM/PM preschool, CIP, and SSP programs begin September 8.
No. It is a 180-day balanced calendar that keeps summer vacation while adding school breaks in October and February.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spokane Public Schools' October break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The new balanced-calendar October break runs October 19–23, 2026. Students return Monday, October 26 on the late-start collaboration schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spokane Public Schools' February break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The balanced-calendar February break runs February 16–19, 2027, immediately after Presidents Day on February 15. Students return Monday, February 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Spokane Public Schools start late every Monday?
calendarFaqs.a: Most instructional Mondays begin one hour late for staff collaboration, but holidays, breaks, and non-student days interrupt the pattern. See the late-start table for the full 2026–27 schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Are SPS weather make-up days automatically school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. June 21–22 are reserved after the scheduled June 17 last day and become attendance days only if Spokane Public Schools activates them.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, using current SPS district events, program pages, calendar pages, the year-at-a-glance PDF, and school-level opening information where needed.
sourceReviewDetails: For program-specific opening dates, current district program and Back to School pages take priority when they provide newer or more detailed information than the year-at-a-glance PDF.

The year-at-a-glance PDF was rendered and checked visually because colors and symbols distinguish late starts, holidays, school breaks, conferences, PLID days, first or last days, and weather reserves.
The kindergarten sequence shown in the PDF differs from current SPS information. This page follows Group A on August 27, Group B on August 28, and all kindergarten students on August 31.

District conference information lists August 24–25. Browne Elementary's opening-date notice extends kindergarten conference appointments through August 26; families should use the dates assigned by their school.
The SPS preschool page confirms September 1 for four-day PreK and September 8 for AM/PM preschool, CIP, and SSP programs.
SPS's balanced-calendar page confirms 180 instructional days and explains that the model is not year-round school.
The late-start Monday dates were transcribed from the gray calendar cells and grouped in one guide.
June 21–22 are marked as Weather/Emergency Makeup Days after the June 17 scheduled last day and remain conditional.
